latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of build-amazon-affiliate-plugin

- Launches a WordPress plugin (“Ad Symbiont”) to display Amazon product ads for affiliate links.
- Detects Amazon links, extracts ASIN, and generates ad units with product information.
- Provides an admin settings page for affiliate tag, display options, and styling controls.
- Supports fallback ads if PA-API is unavailable and caches ad units for better performance.
- Includes Gutenberg block support and adheres to WordPress and Amazon Associates best practices.
